description_for_human: Buy and sell digital goods on the TON blockchain. Browse the catalog, and manage a seller storefront.
description_for_model: TonForge is a TON-blockchain marketplace for digital goods. Public catalog discovery (products, search, offers) needs no auth. Seller actions — manage listings, distribution manifests, and read orders — use a per-seller bearer Personal Access Token that starts with 'tfa_'. The acting wallet is derived from the token. See the OpenAPI spec for endpoints. For native tool-calling integration prefer the MCP server: https://github.com/antsincgame/martket.ton/blob/main/docs/mcp.md . Purchasing is non-custodial: only the buyer's own TON wallet can sign the payment, so an agent discovers and prepares orders but cannot move funds.
